source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Φώτιος και Κύριλλος»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and its whole notice is a single hedged sentence: «Οι Άγιοι Φώτιος και Κύριλλος μάλλον άνηκαν στους 152 Μάρτυρες, που μαρτύρησαν μαζί με τον Άγιο Αρχέλαο (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα)» — the holy Photius and Cyril probably belonged to the 152 martyrs who were martyred with St Archelaus. The «μάλλον», probably, is the site's own word about their company and is recorded here without being acted on; it is not a doubt about either man's existence, and the day's line names both of them plainly. The page gives no country, no year, no emperor, no manner of death, no relic, no distich and no hymn. The corpus keeps ten other men of this name — of Alexandria, of Jerusalem, of Gortyna, of Heliopolis, of Axiopolis, of Zographou, Phileotes, the Philosopher, one of the Forty of Sebaste, and one kept with Nikon and Macarius — and none of them is on this day.
